transcript: Speaker A: Before using the English Seekho app, I struggled to speak even a single sentence in English. summary: A woman shares her success story of learning fluent English using the English Seekho app, accompanied by a satisfying lawn-trimming video on a split screen. She encourages viewers to practice for just 10 minutes daily using the app's expert-led shows. The video ends with a call to action to install the app.
